original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from meta.sas.beacon import emit_beacon

def main():
    path = emit_beacon(
        agent="Axiom II",
        state="Clean",
        tick=285,
        recent_writes_n=0,
        window_ticks=10,
        cooldown_remaining=0,
        path_complexity_est=1.0,
        digestion_intensity=0.0,
        recommended_pace=0.9,
        planned_activity=0.2,
        notes="dry-run v0.1 beacon; sentinel_delta=null"
    )
    print({"emitted_to": path})

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
